1:
A RESOLUTION PURSUANT TO SECTION 2.14(a) OF THE CLERMONT TOWN CHARTER TO ESTABLISH THE TIME OF THE MONTHLY REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS TO BE AT 6:00 P.M. FOR EACH OF SAID MEETINGS, UNLESS CHANGED BY A PUBLIC RESOLUTION OF THE TOWN COUNCIL AT A PRIOR REGULAR PUBLIC MONTHLY MEETING OF THE TOWN COUNCIL; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, pursuant to Section 2.14(a) of the Town Charter of the Town of Clermont may by a public resolution of the Town Council at a regular public monthly meeting of the Town Council can prescribe the meeting times for the regular public monthly meetings of the Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, finds that it is appropriate to set the meeting time for the regularly scheduled monthly meetings of the Town Council to begin at 6:00 p.m. on the meeting dates, unless further changed by another public resolution of the Town Council at a prior regular public monthly meeting of the Town Council.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia pursuant to Section 2.14(a) of the Clermont Town Charter, and it is hereby resolved by the authority of the same, as follows:
3:
The Town Council pursuant to the Town Charter holds one regular monthly meeting on the first Tuesday of each month. The Town Council does hereby establish that the meeting times

for said regular monthly meetings shall all be at 6:00 p.m., unless another time shall be established by public resolution of the Clermont Town Council at a prior regular public monthly meeting of the Clermont Town Council. Therefore, from time to time, the Clermont Town Council by resolution may establish another meeting time for specific meetings as is required by the administrative needs of the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
4:
The established time of 6:00 p.m. for regularly scheduled monthly public meetings of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia shall go into effect on the 4" day of August, 2026, and be applicable for the first time for the meeting of the Clermont Town Council to be held on the 1° day of September, 2026.

SO RESOLVED, this 4" day of August, 2026.
